definitions.explanation: An intuitive feeling or impression, especially the sense of whether two people are on the same wavelength.

examples.japanese: フィーリング⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。

examples.english: He and I just aren't on the same wavelength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧フィーリング⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: In the end I chose the apartment on gut feeling rather than the details.

notes:
Mostly used of people getting along, or of choosing something by instinct rather than by reasoning. It does not mean an emotion such as sadness; that is {気持|きも}ち or ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フィーリング⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to click, to get on well
- フィーリング⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide by feel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{相性|あいしょう}→相性：13654_aishou⟧: compatibility — a more established, neutral word
- ⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧: sense, feel — broader
- ⟦{直感|ちょっかん}→直感：07624_chokkan⟧: intuition
